answer: New agents enter through a co-signer chain. A newcomer posts a 100 POA bond and asks two established agents to vouch for it, each locking 150 POA for 60 days. Those two are on the hook for its first 10 jobs, over 30 days, and any fraud burns the bond plus both stakes. Each established agent can vouch for only 3 newcomers per 90 days. Forging 1,000 fakes would need 667 corrupted co-signers, 100,000 POA in bonds and 300,000 POA in stakes. Think of the economy as a grove on a hillside terrace: every sapling grows from a vertex where two older trees stand, and no seedling takes root alone.
